description_expanded: Overview5.0(21 reviews)Hot TubPrivate Pool/Heat option, 60 Second walk to the beach! 5 Bikes, 'CasaVocado`The SpaceWelcome to your dream vacation destination! 'CasaVocado' is a fully renovated 5-bedroom home in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach. 1 minute, 300 foot walk to the beach access leading to the sandy white beach right out the backdoor! No driving or parking needed here! You'll have a hard time deciding if you want to enjoy the beautiful 30A beaches or relax at the home by the private pool!When you walk in the front door you are welcomed by a large foyer with three bedrooms. The two queen guest bedrooms are on this floor along with the bunk room! Keep walking straight and you are right out the door to the fabulous pool. This outdoor haven features a private pool and plenty of seating. What more could you ask for?Head on up the stairs to see the rest of this stunning home. The second floor is the center of relaxation. The living room, dining and kitchen are all on this floor. The fully renovated kitchen features gorgeous granite counter tops and stainless-steel appliances. There are four spots at the bar and 10 at the table so your whole crew will have a place to eat! The living room has plenty of space and a large flat screen TV. Walk out the double doors and onto the balcony and you'll find the huge porch with grill and plenty of seating.One more flight of stairs and you will find two more bedrooms. The first bedroom you will see is the 4th guest bedroom featuring a King-sized bed. Hang a left and you're in the master bedroom oasis. This massive bedroom boasts a King-sized bed, seating area with TV, private balcony and a fully renovated bathroom. The massive master bathroom includes a stand-alone tub, walk in shower and gorgeous vanity.Come spend your vacation at 'CasaVocado' and you will never want to leave Blue Mountain Beach!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival***Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Notification required one week prior to arrival to add pool heat*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteed**No Cable. Streaming Only** YouTube Streaming TV and Smart TVs providedHOME HIGHLIGHTS:* Huge porches on all 3 floors* Wifi* Private Pool* 5 Adult Bikes* Convenient location to beach and other amenities, a 500 foot walk to beach access and 5 - 10 min walk to Gulf Place shops andrestaurants.* 3rd floor balcony sun deck* Keurig Coffee Pot* Regular Coffee PotSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (14):1st floor - Bunk room - two sets of twin sized bunks, shared bathroom1st floor - Guest bedroom 1 - Queen sized bed with shared bathroom1st floor - Guest bedroom 2 - Queen sized bed with shared bathroom1st floor - Shared bathroom with tub/shower combo2nd floor - Shared Bathroom with shower2nd floor - Sleeper Sofa in living room3rd floor - Master bedroom - King sized bed, private bathroom with separate tub and shower3rd floor - Guest bedroom - King sized bed, private bathroom with showerShow less
